messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — PR #7204 is blocking today's canary cut at 15:00 UTC. It needs 2x LGTM (infra + sec). PR chain: #7204 depends on #7205. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7204

Chris Huang: I'm on an infra pass now, should be able to review in ~20m.

release-bot: Reminder: canary cut window in 45m (15:00 UTC).

Samir Khan: tagging Sec — @Nina Lopez can you do a quick security check? I can assemble notes for threat surface.

Nina Lopez: running quick local tests and a threat surface sketch. one flaky e2e popping on cpu-emulator; if it's a flake we can merge behind feature-flag. I'll report in 15.

Maya Patel: If sec signs off but infra has non-blocking comments, are we comfortable merging behind FF + canary monitor, or do we need strict infra LGTM first? Don't want to miss cutoff.

Chris Huang: prefer infra LGTM first, but if Sec gives a clean sign and we can gate with FF + auto-fallback, I'll prioritize the review and give provisional +1.

Samir Khan: thanks — adding a short threat-model note to the PR now.

Nina Lopez: Sec review complete — minor logging/retention comment (non-blocking). LGTM from security.

Maya Patel: Great. Chris — can you finish infra pass? We need the second approval to merge before 15:00.

Chris Huang: done — LGTM. Left one optional refactor comment but not blocking. Merging conditions look safe with FF.

release-bot: Canary cutoff in 5m.

Maya Patel: Merging into canary branch and enabling feature flag now. Monitoring on #incidents and dashboards (grafana -> canary-kv-latency). If anything anomalous, we'll roll back immediately. :crossed_fingers:

Nina Lopez: :thumbsup:

Samir Khan: thanks all — will follow up with a short post-mortem checklist and QA notes if we see any regressions.
